description: This Java class represents a decision regarding credits in a cleanup process, indicating how many credits to grant and providing an explanation.

classes.name: CreditDecision
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating a credit decision with a specified amount and explanation.

methods.name: no

methods.name: yes
methods.description: Creates a CreditDecision instance with specified credits and explanation.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the amount of credit granted.

methods.description: Returns the explanation for the credit decision.

methods.description: Checks equality with another CreditDecision object.
